---
title: "Where each region stands"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
latest <- read_csv("unemployment.csv") |>
  filter(date == max(date))
kingdom <- latest |>
  filter(region == "Kingdom") |>
  pull(rate)
regions <- latest |>
  filter(region != "Kingdom")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.5
ggplot(regions,
       aes(rate, fct_reorder(region, rate))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = kingdom,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_col(width = 0.7)
```
